name: Noteey
description_en:
Noteey is an offline-first visual knowledge workspace for Mac and Windows. It puts cards, PDFs, images, mind maps, video/audio notes and drawings on an infinite canvas. Local projects are distinct from optional web publishing and AI services.

Its commercial model separates free local limits, lifetime desktop licences and Premium cloud/AI plans. Do not describe the entire product as subscription-only or assume a desktop licence includes unlimited online services.
description_zh:
Noteey 是面向 Mac 和 Windows 的离线优先可视化知识工作区，把卡片、PDF、图片、思维导图、音视频笔记和绘图放在无限画布中。本地项目与可选网页发布、AI 服务有所区分。

其商业模式区分免费本地限制、桌面终身许可与 Premium 云端／AI 方案，不能把全部产品写成仅订阅，也不能默认桌面许可包含不限量在线服务。

core_features.explanation_en: Combine PDFs, cards, video/audio timestamps and drawings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结合 PDF、卡片、音视频时间戳和绘图。

core_features.explanation_en: Keep projects on the device; premium services have separate account conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 项目保存在设备上，高级服务有独立账户条件。

core_features.explanation_en: Desktop licences have limited publishing; Premium adds online allowances.
core_features.explanation_zh: 桌面许可提供有限发布，Premium 增加在线额度。

en: Link PDF highlights and video timestamps on a research canvas.
zh: 在研究画布关联 PDF 高亮和视频时间戳。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Mac/Windows local desktop app with optional online Premium services.
Deployment.zh: Mac／Windows 本地桌面应用，可选在线 Premium 服务。

steps.en: Download Mac/Windows app and create a small local project without signup.
steps.zh: 下载 Mac／Windows 应用，无需注册建立小型本地项目。

steps.en: Annotate a PDF and add a timestamped video note, then reopen the project.
steps.zh: 批注 PDF 并添加时间戳视频笔记，再重新打开项目。

steps.en: Evaluate local backup and any third-party sync separately from Premium publishing.
steps.zh: 将本地备份／第三方同步与 Premium 发布分别评估。

items.en: Noteey merits evaluation for local visual research with large source context and offline access. A team requiring centrally governed live collaboration needs separate proof. Terms distinguish proprietary site content from user-created canvas material, which users may distribute commercially; that does not establish an open-source application licence. AI online services also need a separate data-handling review rather than extending the local-storage claim to every feature. No local recovery, cross-device conflicts, AI quality or publishing permission test was performed.
items.zh: 对于需要来源上下文与离线访问的本地可视化研究，Noteey 值得评估。若团队需要集中治理的实时协作，必须另有证据。条款区分专有网站内容与用户画布作品，允许用户商业分发自己的画布；这不证明应用本身开源。在线 AI 服务也需单独核对数据处理，不能把本地存储声明扩大到全部功能。未测试本地恢复、跨设备冲突、AI 质量或发布权限。

pricing.billing_basis: One-time desktop licence or optional Premium online plan.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free local limits; Desktop Pro $99/4 devices, Plus $159/8; Premium $10/month, $90/year or displayed $599 lifetime. 30-day refund; offers subject to change.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费本地有上限；Desktop Pro 99／四设备，Plus 159／八设备；Premium 每月 10、每年 90 或展示的 599 终身方案。30 天退款，方案可能变化。

Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_en: Put source excerpts beside your explanation
sections.title_zh: 把来源摘录放在自己的解释旁
sections.en: For an illustrative video-and-PDF study session, annotate a PDF, make timestamp-linked video notes and arrange highlight cards beside your own explanation on a canvas. Floating windows allow multiple sources to stay visible; unique links identify cards and blocks. The usefulness comes from preserving source context, not simply accumulating a larger board. Check a timestamp and source annotation after reopening the local project before using it for a substantial research archive.
sections.zh: 例如结合视频与 PDF 学习时，可批注 PDF，创建关联时间戳的视频笔记，再把高亮卡片与自己的解释放在同一画布。浮动窗口使多个来源同时可见，卡片和块有独立链接。价值来自保留来源上下文，而非仅把画板做大。用于大量研究归档前，应重新打开本地项目，核对时间戳与来源批注。

sections.title_zh: 本地文件与第三方同步
sections.en: The homepage says data is stored on the device and an account is needed for premium features. The pricing FAQ says Google Drive or iCloud can sync data while native cloud sync is still planned. That is a file-sync dependency, not proof of concurrent team editing or conflict-free merging. Keep local backups and avoid simultaneous edits until the actual sync/recovery behaviour is checked. Sharing a project copy is different from maintaining one live shared workspace.
sections.zh: 首页说明数据保存在设备上，高级功能需要账户。定价 FAQ 说明可通过 Google Drive 或 iCloud 同步数据，原生云同步仍在规划。这属于文件同步依赖，不能证明支持团队同时编辑或无冲突合并。建议保留本地备份，在核实实际同步／恢复前避免同时编辑。分享项目副本与维护一个实时共享工作区不同。

sections.title_en: Desktop lifetime and online Premium are separate
sections.title_zh: 桌面终身许可与在线 Premium 分开
sections.en: Free lists three projects, 100 cards and annotation of three PDFs plus three videos/audio items, with no signup. Desktop Pro is displayed at $99 for four devices and Pro Plus $159 for eight, one-time, with unlimited local projects and limited web publishing up to 20 MB. Premium displays $10/month, $90/year or a $599 lifetime offer and bundles Desktop Pro with unlimited publishing and AI/transcript services. A banner says the offer/model may change. The page states a 30-day refund guarantee; it is not a free trial.
sections.zh: Free 列出三项目、100 卡片，以及三份 PDF 和三份视频／音频的批注，无需注册。Desktop Pro 显示一次性 99、四设备，Pro Plus 159、八设备，均含不限本地项目及最高 20 MB 的有限网页发布。Premium 显示每月 10、每年 90 或 599 终身方案，把 Desktop Pro 与不限发布和 AI／转录服务组合。横幅说明方案／模式可能变化。页面列 30 天退款保证，这不是免费试用。
